senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. pl. Rephidim, a station in the wilderness.
units: Bekh. 5ᵇ שאלתיו מאי לשון ר׳ ואמר לי ר׳ שמה I asked him (R. Eliezer), what is the meaning of r’phidim?, and he told me, the name of the place is R.; Snh. 106ᵃ; Tanḥ.
